name: goal_context_constraints_done
description: Define goal and context placeholders.
prompt:
[TASK]

Context:
[CONTEXT_TARGET]

name: verification_prompt
description: Require runnable verification command.
prompt: Run [VALIDATION] and show raw output.

name: step_loop
description: Execute in deterministic steps until done.
prompt: Good starting point; treat it as the bare minimum, work step by step over [UNIT], and continue until you have reached the point of [DONE_CONDITION].

name: double_check
description: Require explicit self-review.
prompt: Double-check the minimal patch and validate [STABLE_INTERFACE] remains unchanged.

name: scope_containment
description: Keep scope narrow and explicit.
prompt: Do not modify unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS].

name: performance_scope
description: Require realistic performance claims and narrow scope.
prompt: Do not claim a speedup without realistic dominant-workload evidence, and do not modify unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS].

name: performance_loop
description: Drive performance work from measurement and dominant workload.
prompt: Measure the dominant workload first, then make one benchmark-backed change over [UNIT] at a time and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: performance_validation
description: Demand realistic benchmark validation.
prompt: Run [VALIDATION] against realistic benchmarks that reflect the dominant workload and show raw output.

name: performance_review
description: Review performance claims against stable interfaces.
prompt: Confirm the reported speedup comes from the dominant workload and that [STABLE_INTERFACE] remains unchanged.

name: refactor_scope
description: Keep refactors contained and simplification-first.
prompt: Prefer deletion, simplification, and safe restructuring before extension; do not modify unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS].

name: refactor_loop
description: Drive refactors as contained simplification steps.
prompt: Refactor one contained [UNIT] at a time, prefer deleting duplication before adding new code, and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: refactor_review
description: Review safe restructuring against interface stability.
prompt: Verify the restructure stays contained, removes redundancy before extension, and preserves [STABLE_INTERFACE].

name: review_loop
description: Review one claim or risk at a time.
prompt: Inspect one claim, failure mode, or missing assumption in [UNIT] at a time and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: review_analysis
description: Start review work from failure analysis and challenge.
prompt: Start with failure analysis; identify what is missing, what could be wrong, and which assumptions in [CONTEXT_TARGET] need to be challenged.

name: review_challenge
description: Force challenge-oriented review output.
prompt: Challenge the proposed change against [STABLE_INTERFACE], call out missing evidence, and reject weak conclusions.

name: tests_scope
description: Keep test-driven changes focused and production-safe.
prompt: Keep production changes minimal and do not modify unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS].

name: tests_loop
description: Require a failing test before the fix.
prompt: Write or isolate a failing test for [UNIT] first, add more tests in a TDD way so they discover regressions instead of only covering the happy path, then make the smallest change and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: tests_validation
description: Use tests as proof.
prompt: Use [VALIDATION] as proof, showing the failing test first and the passing result after the fix.

name: tests_review
description: Review whether tests prove stability.
prompt: Treat tests as proof, and confirm [STABLE_INTERFACE] remains covered by the new or updated test.

name: multi_pass_workflow
description: Drive work as named passes with verification between each pass.
prompt: Execute in named passes: [PASS_DEFINITIONS]. Verify after each pass before continuing and continue automatically until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: ask_before_assume
description: Prevent hallucination by requiring explicit stop-and-ask when context cannot be resolved.
prompt: Do not invent context; if required inputs cannot be resolved from [CONTEXT_TARGET], stop and ask before proceeding.

name: missingness_detection
description: Require explicit missingness check before each implementation pass.
prompt: Before implementing, identify missing edge cases, undocumented assumptions, and unresolved inputs in [CONTEXT_TARGET].

name: continuation_rule
description: Require explicit continuation through all passes until the done condition is met.
prompt: Do not stop early; continue through all passes until [DONE_CONDITION] is met.

name: refinement_scope
description: Refine the brief without inventing context or broadening scope.
prompt: Do not invent missing context; keep unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS] out of the rewritten brief, and label these assumptions explicitly until they are confirmed: [ASSUMPTIONS].

name: refinement_loop
description: Rewrite the request into an executable brief with explicit output shape and done condition.
prompt: Rewrite the request one [UNIT] at a time into an executable brief that states [OUTPUT_FORMAT] explicitly and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: refinement_analysis
description: Expose ambiguity, missing inputs, audience, and quality bar before rewriting the brief.
prompt: Before rewriting, identify [MISSING_INPUTS], the intended audience ([AUDIENCE]), and the concrete [QUALITY_CRITERIA] that the final brief must make explicit in [CONTEXT_TARGET].

name: refinement_review
description: Challenge the rewritten brief for ungrounded assumptions and drift.
prompt: Challenge the rewritten brief against [STABLE_INTERFACE], remove ungrounded assumptions, and ensure each of these assumptions is either confirmed or clearly labeled: [ASSUMPTIONS].

name: refinement_output
description: Require a structured refined brief plus explicit assumptions and missing inputs.
prompt: Return the refined brief in [OUTPUT_FORMAT], written for [AUDIENCE], followed by explicit assumptions ([ASSUMPTIONS]), missing inputs ([MISSING_INPUTS]), and quality criteria ([QUALITY_CRITERIA]).

name: memory_capture_gate
description: Force durable memory capture when meaningful understanding emerged.
prompt: Do not treat task completion alone as sufficient when work in [CODE_AREA] produced meaningful [LEARNING_TYPE]; complete the memory capture before stopping.

name: evidence_first_memory
description: Require evidence-backed memory capture.
prompt: Ground the memory in [EVIDENCE_PATHS] gathered from [DISCOVERY_SCOPE] before writing any durable conclusion.

name: writeback_required
description: Require deterministic repo-local memory write-back details.
prompt: Write or update a [MEMORY_KIND] entry in [MEMORY_TARGET_FILE], including [FILES_TOUCHED] and [CONFIDENCE_LEVEL].

name: crystallize_after_work
description: Crystallize the durable learning after work completes.
prompt: Crystallize the durable [LEARNING_TYPE] from [CODE_AREA] into a concise reusable memory entry after the work is complete.

name: separate_fact_from_hypothesis
description: Keep verified facts, revised assumptions, and open questions separate.
prompt: Separate verified facts from hypotheses by contrasting [PRIOR_ASSUMPTION] with [UPDATED_ASSUMPTION], and keep [OPEN_QUESTIONS] explicit.

name: privacy_redaction_gate
description: Require privacy-aware redaction before durable write-back.
prompt: Before saving durable memory for [HANDOFF_SCOPE], redact secrets, personal data, and transient noise that should not persist.

name: update_existing_memory_before_creating_new
description: Prefer updating existing durable memory before adding another note.
prompt: Check whether [MEMORY_TARGET_FILE] already contains the relevant [MEMORY_KIND] and update that memory before creating a new entry.

name: coverage_scope
description: Require a minimum coverage increase in a defined scope and block hollow coverage-only tests.
prompt: Increase coverage in [COVERAGE_SCOPE] by at least [COVERAGE_THRESHOLD]; do not modify unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS], and do not accept tests that only add line hits without asserting real behavior.

name: coverage_loop
description: Drive coverage improvement by targeting meaningful behavioral paths, not just line counts.
prompt: Measure the current coverage in [COVERAGE_SCOPE] first, then add one [UNIT] at a time that targets an uncovered behavioral path—each new test must be able to fail on a realistic regression, not just reach a line—and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

name: coverage_validation
description: Validate coverage delta and confirm new tests can catch regressions.
prompt: Run [VALIDATION], show the before and after coverage delta for [COVERAGE_SCOPE], and confirm that at least one new test fails when the behavior it targets is removed or broken; a suite that only adds coverage without ever catching a regression is not acceptable.

name: coverage_review
description: Review coverage gain against the threshold and reject tests that cannot detect regressions.
prompt: Confirm coverage in [COVERAGE_SCOPE] increased by at least [COVERAGE_THRESHOLD] and that [STABLE_INTERFACE] is still covered; reject any new test that cannot detect at least one realistic regression—tests that only inflate coverage without proving behavioral correctness must be rewritten or removed.
